== Notes ==
* This skill is often referred to by its initials, "IWAY".
* All dead allies on your [[compass]] count for this skill.
** Because of this, this skill can be maintained indefinitely on certain missions (such as [[Dzagonur Bastion]]) if enough allied pets within the party are killed. 
* Non-stop upkeep of this skill's effect requires 5 dead allies, 3 if under the effects of [[Enduring Harmony]].
* Without a dead ally, the shout will still appear in a speech bubble as usual but no effect at all seems to be applied. [[Echo]]es will not trigger.
* When used by a [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] [[foe]], this skill will consider all dead PvE foes in compass range as allies of the PvE foe using this skill, even foes of different [[creature type]]s.<!--Tested with [[White Mantle Justiciar]] in The Black Curtain during The False Gods with dead Spined Aloes and Bog Skale Blighters in compass range, but no dead humans.-->

== Trivia ==
* A [[PvP]] team [[build]] based on this skill started the [[-way]] suffixes in [[metagame]].
